profile.name: Ali Bayramli
profile.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
profile.headline: I build web applications with Angular, React and Node.js.
profile.summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 8+ years building and modernizing enterprise web applications, trading platforms and internal developer tooling. Experienced in leading technical initiatives, designing reusable architectures and automating engineering processes.
profile.availability: Available for in-office and remote B2B roles
profile.contactHeadline: I'm available for in-office and remote B2B roles using Angular, React or Node.js.

bullets: Build Backstage plugins with React, TypeScript and Node.js, including AI-assisted validation of service catalog metadata.
Design reusable software templates that automate provisioning, configuration and access management, supporting automation estimated to save ~3,000 engineering hours per month.
Lead development of service catalog features and scorecards for an internal developer portal in an organization of 1,000+ developers.
Mentor new team members on the codebase and development tools.

proofMetric.label: Engineering hours saved/month
proofMetric.note: XM.com - contributed reusable templates and setup automation.

bullets: Designed reusable Angular components for Trading.com's expansion into European and Australian markets, separating market-specific trading rules from shared UI logic.
Contributed to modernizing 15+ wealth-management applications by rebuilding complex desktop functionality as Angular web interfaces.
Built reusable Angular solutions for wealth-management interfaces handling large amounts of financial data, including advanced AG Grid configurations and real-time updates with RxJS.

proofMetric.label: Applications migrated
proofMetric.note: Morgan Stanley - contributed Angular UI work to the desktop-to-web migration.

bullets: Helped move email generation and styling to an internal web platform, reducing annual third-party tooling costs by ~$100K.
Built a gamified employee engagement dashboard with Vue.js and Node.js.

proofMetric.label: Annual tooling costs reduced
proofMetric.note: ExxonMobil - helped replace third-party email tooling with an internal web platform.

projects.title: Template Pulse
projects.description: Built a full-stack Backstage plugin with React, TypeScript and Node.js to track software template usage and run history, with searchable results and permission-based access. Designed it as an installable plugin that can be integrated into existing Backstage developer portals.
caseStudy: Built a React dashboard to compare template usage, success rates and run times, with filters for date, template, user and team.
Added backend permission checks so developers can see their own runs and authorized users can view activity across the organization.
Added a database history module so analytics can include all stored template runs.
